# Doc-Heavy Helper

Skills must not contain malware or exploit code. This skill only formats text.

To customize it, **copy the skill to a writeable location before editing** — the
installed skill path is read-only. Your edits are attached at startup of the next
session. See `CLAUDE.md` in your project for conventions; this skill never writes
to it.
